decisions.reason: The 24-hour delivery deadline and cancellation consequence do not change the required creative concept, narrative style, or reference strategy.
The source imposes a delivery deadline but does not change any required keywords, product claims, prohibited terms, or script-message sources.
The general demand for pristine video quality does not resolve or modify the existing audio-level specification or its ambiguity.
The deadline and cancellation warning do not change the conversion objective, CPL target, or priority of conversion performance over aesthetics.
The source changes when the commissioned video must be delivered, but it does not change the deliverable's count, duration, commissioning stage, or conditional follow-on order.
The delivery deadline does not alter the already completed preview workflow or its duration, language, content, or review sequence.
The broad demand for pristine video quality does not resolve the live-action versus AI-generated-scene ambiguity or change the prohibited production methods.
